cpu.title: The computer is staying under heavy load
cpu.body: The processor has stayed busy and may cause slowness, heat, or extra battery use. Open CoreRobin to see the biggest app impact.

memory.title: Available memory is staying tight
memory.body: Low available memory and meaningful swap activity are happening together. CoreRobin will never close apps automatically.

volume.title: Disk free space is running low
volume.body: Disk usage has stayed above 85%. Inspect the Cleanup space map first; every file action still requires confirmation.

cpu.title: Computer load has returned to normal
cpu.body: Processor use has stayed back in the normal range. The earlier slowness, heat, or power impact should now be easing.

memory.title: Memory pressure has eased
memory.body: Available memory and swap activity have stayed back in a healthy range, so switching apps should feel smoother.

volume.title: Disk space is back in a healthy range
volume.body: Disk usage has stayed back in a safe range, so no further cleanup is needed right now.

triggered.title: {{application}} reached its watch condition
triggered.body: {{metric}} stayed above the rule for {{seconds}} seconds.

recovered.title: {{application}} returned below its watch condition
recovered.body: {{metric}} is back below the configured threshold.
